_comment: Pins the content artifact this app is built against. Generated and updated by
`nz app sync` in the arshad-shah/nimaz-data repository; edit by hand only to roll back.
The artifact is fetched and sha256-verified by the fetchNimazData Gradle task, then
wired in as a generated assets source root, so createFromAsset keeps working unchanged.
It is not committed here: LFS stores every version whole, so a one-row correction used
to cost another 140 MB object forever.
